create.heading: Create a product
create.intro: Fill in the Swedish content below (required), define any variation options like color or size (optional — skip it for a single, simple product), then add at least one variant with a price and tax class.
create.section1Hint: Swedish content is required. English is optional — add it now or later from the product's page.
create.slugHint: Generated automatically from Name — edit it here to override.
create.optionsHint: Variation dimensions like color or size — optional. Leave empty for a product with a single variant.
create.skuHint: Optional — your own business/vendor code, if you use one. A permanent Article Number is generated automatically.
create.initialStockDisabledHint: Enable "Tracks stock" below to set a starting quantity.
create.imagesHint: Add one or more images now, or skip this and add them later from the product's page.
